name: MIKA3D
summary: Amazon-first PLA brand selling silk, metallic silk, dual-colour silk, rainbow, standard and wood PLA in 1 kg spools and mini-spool bundles. An affiliate directory carries a self-description as a 'Professional 3D Filament Factory' offering OEM and private-label PLA, which is unverified. Legal entity and location are unknown.

product_lines.name: Silk PLA (single colour, metallic, Silk Metal)
product_lines.notes: 1 kg singles and 6-12 spool bundles; about $18-23/kg.

product_lines.name: Dual Color Silk PLA (fast colour change)
Standard PLA (250 g bundles)
product_lines.notes: 2.85 mm PLA also seen on eBay.

additional_notes: Store is Amazon US, also resold on Newegg; no brand website found. Self-claimed manufactures-for unnamed private-label clients (affiliate directory blurb: 'Mika3d is the Professional 3D Filament Factory, which offering OEM service and produce Private Label PLA Filament'); because no client is named and the claim is unverified, no relationship item is recorded. The deal tracker also lists the name as 'OEM MIKA3D' with no evidence of a separate entity. A candidate OEM for other silk-PLA Amazon brands, but nothing links it to any.

provenance.conflicts: No legal entity, address or trademark owner could be retrieved (Amazon pages not fetchable). The factory/OEM claim is self-reported only.
